title: NullPointerException hits different at 2am
caption: When Java decides your entire project is null 💀 #java #coding #programmer
transcript_excerpt: So you're running your first real project, everything compiles, you hit run... and then Java just goes 'Exception in thread main java.lang.NullPointerException at line 47.' You didn't ask for this. Nobody asked for this.

title: A day in the life of a SWE in Bengaluru
caption: 9am standup to 6pm deploy — what I actually do 🏙️ #swife #bengaluru #techjobs
transcript_excerpt: I get into office around nine thirty, grab coffee, and the first thing I do is check if anything broke in prod overnight. By noon I'm deep in code review. The afternoon is usually design discussions or pair programming. People think we just type all day — there's a lot more talking than you'd expect.

title: POV: interviewer asks you to reverse a linked list
caption: The panic is real 😭 #leetcode #codinginterview #dsa #swe
transcript_excerpt: Interviewer: 'Can you reverse a linked list?' Me, who just watched three YouTube tutorials on it: 'Absolutely.' Me, five seconds into the whiteboard: ... okay so we have... a node... and it has a next... and we want... the next to be the previous... wait.

title: 16GB vs 8GB MacBook — is the upgrade worth it for devs?
caption: I bought both so you don't have to. Real dev workloads tested 💻 #macbook #developer #laptop
transcript_excerpt: Running IntelliJ, a local Postgres, and Chrome with twenty tabs — the 8GB model starts swapping at about seventy percent memory utilization. The 16GB handles it comfortably. If you're doing anything with Docker containers, the 8GB is going to hurt. For frontend-only work, honestly? 8GB is probably fine.

caption: The OG street food experience 🔥 #streetfood #delhi #foodie

caption: How did I survive this 💀 #bgmi #mobilegaming #gaming #clutch

title: Snapdragon X Elite just changed mobile compute
caption: The benchmark numbers are wild 📊 #snapdragon #chips #tech #hardware
transcript_excerpt: Qualcomm's new X Elite pulls 13 TOPS on the neural processing unit. For context, last generation was pushing 4. That's not incremental — that's a platform shift. The implications for on-device inference are significant.

title: Stop wasting time. Grind now. Your future depends on it.
caption: No excuses. Just results. 💪 #motivation #grind #success
transcript_excerpt: Every minute you spend scrolling is a minute your competitor is grinding. Champions aren't born. They're forged in the hours you refuse to give up. Are you willing to pay the price?
